Tables: bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions
Range: block_date between @start and @end (partition column).
Dry-run bytes: about 9 to 10 GB per day of history (8.5 to 10.2 GB measured for single days in 2024 and
         2025), roughly 20 TB from genesis. NOT RUN in this build: far above the 300 GB budget. The
         sampler applies the same rule to sampled transactions through RPC state instead
         (scripts/sample-chain.ts), and scripts/lib/classify.ts permissionAt() is its tested twin.
body:
SELECT
  receipt_receiver_account_id AS account_id,
  JSON_VALUE(args, '$.public_key') AS public_key,
  action_kind,
  CASE
    WHEN action_kind = 'DELETE_KEY' THEN NULL
    WHEN JSON_VALUE(args, '$.access_key.permission') = 'FullAccess' THEN 'FullAccess'
    WHEN JSON_QUERY(args, '$.access_key.permission.FunctionCall') IS NOT NULL THEN 'FunctionCall'
  END AS permission_kind,
  JSON_VALUE(args, '$.access_key.permission.FunctionCall.receiver_id') AS fc_receiver_id,
  JSON_QUERY(args, '$.access_key.permission.FunctionCall.method_names') AS fc_method_names,
  JSON_VALUE(args, '$.access_key.permission.FunctionCall.allowance') AS fc_allowance,
  block_timestamp,
  receipt_id,
  index_in_action_receipt
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions`
WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start AND @end
  AND action_kind IN ('ADD_KEY', 'DELETE_KEY')

purpose: classify each transaction by its signing key at signing time: the latest ADD_KEY for (signer, public key) strictly before the transaction with no DELETE_KEY after it and before the transaction. Delegate actions (NEP-366) are classified by the inner signer. Same rule as scripts/lib/classify.ts (permissionAt, classify); one documented difference: SQL cannot base58-decode, so a 64-hex implicit signer with no key event is IMPLICIT_FULL whatever its key, where the TypeScript twin checks that the key derives the name.
header:
02_tx_classified.sql
Purpose: classify each transaction by its signing key at signing time: the latest ADD_KEY for
         (signer, public key) strictly before the transaction with no DELETE_KEY after it and
         before the transaction. Delegate actions (NEP-366) are classified by the inner signer.
         Same rule as scripts/lib/classify.ts (permissionAt, classify); one documented difference:
         SQL cannot base58-decode, so a 64-hex implicit signer with no key event is IMPLICIT_FULL
         whatever its key, where the TypeScript twin checks that the key derives the name.
Tables: transactions, transaction_actions, and key_events (sql/01 materialised as
         `@project.keytell.key_events`). The CTEs `tx`, `del` and `ke` are replaced by fixtures in
         tests (BigQuery WITH fixtures), so the logic runs on tiny tables.
Range: block_date between @start and @end.
Dry-run bytes: depends on key_events; NOT RUN in this build (sql/01 is above budget).
body:
WITH
tx AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash, signer_account_id, signer_public_key, block_timestamp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
  WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start AND @end
),
del AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash,
    JSON_VALUE(args, '$.Delegate.delegate_action.sender_id') AS inner_signer,
    JSON_VALUE(args, '$.Delegate.delegate_action.public_key') AS inner_public_key
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transaction_actions`
  WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start AND @end AND action_kind = 'DELEGATE_ACTION'
),
ke AS (
  SELECT account_id, public_key, action_kind, permission_kind, block_timestamp, index_in_action_receipt
  FROM `keytell.key_events`
),
signing AS (
  SELECT tx.transaction_hash, tx.block_timestamp,
    COALESCE(del.inner_signer, tx.signer_account_id) AS account_id,
    COALESCE(del.inner_public_key, tx.signer_public_key) AS public_key,
    del.transaction_hash IS NOT NULL AS delegated
  FROM tx LEFT JOIN del USING (transaction_hash)
),
latest AS (
  SELECT s.*, ke.action_kind, ke.permission_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.transaction_hash
                       ORDER BY ke.block_timestamp DESC, ke.index_in_action_receipt DESC) AS rn
  FROM signing s
  LEFT JOIN ke ON ke.account_id = s.account_id AND ke.public_key = s.public_key AND ke.block_timestamp < s.block_timestamp
)
SELECT transaction_hash, account_id, public_key, delegated,
  CASE
    WHEN action_kind = 'ADD_KEY' AND permission_kind = 'FunctionCall' THEN IF(delegated, 'DELEGATED_INNER_FC', 'FUNCTION_CALL')
    WHEN action_kind = 'ADD_KEY' AND permission_kind = 'FullAccess' THEN IF(delegated, 'DELEGATED_INNER_FULL', 'FULL_ACCESS')
    WHEN action_kind IS NULL AND NOT delegated AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(account_id, r'^[0-9a-f]{64}$') THEN 'IMPLICIT_FULL'
    WHEN action_kind IS NULL AND delegated AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(account_id, r'^[0-9a-f]{64}$') THEN 'DELEGATED_INNER_FULL'
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS bucket
FROM latest
WHERE rn = 1
not_run_reason: NOT RUN in this build (sql/01 is above budget).

header:
05_usdc_volume.sql
Purpose: the primary outcome. Daily USDC moved on NEAR by NEP-141 ft_transfer events, native USDC
         (contract id from Circle's documentation) and bridged USDC.e, counting the receiving side
         of each transfer once (positive deltas only), successful events only.
Tables: bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.ft_events
Range: block_date between @start and @end (partition column).
Dry-run bytes: 20.3 GB for 2022-01-03 to 2026-11-08 (measured 13 Nov 2026).
body:
SELECT
  block_date,
  contract_account_id,
  COUNT(*) AS transfers,
  CAST(SUM(SAFE_CAST(delta_amount AS BIGNUMERIC)) / 1000000 AS FLOAT64) AS usdc
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.ft_events`
WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start AND @end
  AND contract_account_id IN (
    '17208628f84f5d6ad33f0da3bbbeb27ffcb398eac501a31bd6ad2011e36133a1',
    'a0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48.factory.bridge.near')
  AND cause = 'ft_transfer'
  AND status LIKE 'SUCCESS%'
  AND SAFE_CAST(delta_amount AS BIGNUMERIC) > 0
GROUP BY block_date, contract_account_id
ORDER BY block_date, contract_account_id

purpose: secondary outcome, 30-day retained signers: accounts that signed in week t and again in any of weeks t+4 to t+8, per week t.
header:
06_retention.sql
Purpose: secondary outcome, 30-day retained signers: accounts that signed in week t and again in
         any of weeks t+4 to t+8, per week t.
Tables: bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions
Range: block_date between @start and @end (partition column).
Dry-run bytes: about 154 GB for 2022-01-03 to 2026-11-08 on top of sql/04, which takes the rebuild
         over its 300 GB budget. NOT RUN in this build; reported as not computable within budget.
body:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT signer_account_id AS a, DATE_TRUNC(block_date, ISOWEEK) AS wk
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
  WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start AND @end
)
SELECT w.wk AS week_monday,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.a) AS signers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.a IS NOT NULL, w.a, NULL)) AS retained_4_to_8_weeks
FROM w
LEFT JOIN w AS l
  ON l.a = w.a AND l.wk BETWEEN DATE_ADD(w.wk, INTERVAL 4 WEEK) AND DATE_ADD(w.wk, INTERVAL 8 WEEK)
GROUP BY week_monday
ORDER BY week_monday
not_run_reason: NOT RUN in this build; reported as not computable within budget.

header:
08_concentration.sql
Purpose: concentration of function-call activity: share of FC-signed transactions per receiver
         contract the key was scoped to, per week, from sql/02 joined to key scope.
Tables: `keytell.tx_classified` (sql/02) and `keytell.key_events` (sql/01).
Dry-run bytes: depends on sql/01 and sql/02; NOT RUN in this build. analysis/weekly.py computes the
         same concentration from the block sample (fc_receivers.csv, concentration_top10.json).
body:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(t.block_date, ISOWEEK) AS week_monday, k.fc_receiver_id, COUNT(*) AS fc_transactions
FROM `keytell.tx_classified` t
JOIN `keytell.key_events` k ON k.account_id = t.account_id AND k.public_key = t.public_key AND k.action_kind = 'ADD_KEY'
WHERE t.bucket IN ('FUNCTION_CALL', 'DELEGATED_INNER_FC') AND t.block_date BETWEEN @start AND @end
GROUP BY week_monday, k.fc_receiver_id
ORDER BY week_monday, fc_transactions DESC
